library for cryptography on the secp256k1 curve. However, the primary
focus of its development has been for usage in the Bitcoin system and
usage unlike Bitcoin's may be less well tested, verified, or suffer
from a less well thought out interface. Correct usage requires some
care and consideration that the library is fit for your application's purpose.
about.summary: Optimized C library for ECDSA signatures and secret/public key operations on curve secp256k1.

raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json

context:
  name: libsecp256k1
  version: "0.8.0"
  # Look in the upstream CMakeLists.txt for the library version -- it is NOT the
  # same as the project version. Upstream does some arithmetic to convert
  # lib_version into so_version. Re-check both values on every version bump.
  so_version: "7.0.0"
  so_major_version: "7"
  library: ${{ "" if unix else "Library/" }}

recipe:
  name: libsecp256k1-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/bitcoin-core/secp256k1/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: eb52b0e9239dff7dc26be5f9623567141b8720ec47da29eb3c1e0a660d17c8bb

build:
  number: 1

# Build once, then split the installed files across the two outputs below.
outputs:
  - staging:
      name: build-cache
    build:
      script:
        file: build.sh
        interpreter: brush
    requirements:
      build:
      - ${{ compiler('c') }}
      - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
      - brush
      - cmake >=3.26
      - ninja

  - package:
      name: libsecp256k1
      version: ${{ version }}
    inherit: build-cache
    build:
      # This package ships only headers, cmake/pkg-config files and the
      # unversioned .so symlink - nothing with a DT_NEEDED record - so the
      # run dependency on libsecp256k1-N is invisible to the overdepending
      # check even though the symlink target and the .pc file both resolve
      # into it. Suppress here only; keep the check active for other outputs.
      dynamic_linking:
        overdepending_behavior: ignore
      files:
        - ${{ library }}include/secp256k1*
        - ${{ library }}lib/pkgconfig/libsecp256k1.pc
        - ${{ library }}lib/cmake/libsecp256k1/*
        - ${{ library }}lib/libsecp256k1.${{ "so" if linux else "dylib" if osx else "lib" }}
        - if: not unix
          then:
            - ${{ library }}lib/secp256k1.lib
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libsecp256k1-' ~ so_major_version, exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libsecp256k1-' ~ so_major_version, exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libsecp256k1-' ~ so_major_version) }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          strict: true
          include:
            - secp256k1.h
            - secp256k1_ecdh.h
            - secp256k1_ellswift.h
            - secp256k1_extrakeys.h
            - secp256k1_musig.h
            - secp256k1_preallocated.h
            - secp256k1_recovery.h
            - secp256k1_schnorrsig.h
            - secp256k1_silentpayments.h
          lib:
            - if: unix
              then:
                - libsecp256k1
          files:
            - if: not unix
              then:
                - ${{ library }}lib/libsecp256k1.lib
                - ${{ library }}lib/secp256k1.lib
            - ${{ library }}lib/cmake/libsecp256k1/libsecp256k1-config.cmake
            - ${{ library }}lib/cmake/libsecp256k1/libsecp256k1-config-version.cmake
            - ${{ library }}lib/cmake/libsecp256k1/libsecp256k1-targets.cmake
            - ${{ library }}lib/cmake/libsecp256k1/libsecp256k1-targets-release.cmake
            - ${{ library }}lib/pkgconfig/libsecp256k1.pc
            # Test artifacts
            - etc/conda/test-files/libsecp256k1/*

      - script:
          - pkg-config --exists libsecp256k1
        requirements:
          build:
            - pkg-config

      - script:
          interpreter: brush
          content: |
            # Standalone build against the installed library. The upstream
            # sources needed to compile the tests are staged here at test
            # time (see `files:` below) rather than being copied into the
            # recipe directory during the build.
            cp src/tests.c src/tests_exhaustive.c src/secp256k1.c shared_standalone_tests/src/
            cp -R src/modules src/wycheproof shared_standalone_tests/src/
            cp src/*.h shared_standalone_tests/src/
            cp -R cmake shared_standalone_tests/src/
            cp -R include contrib shared_standalone_tests/
            cd shared_standalone_tests
            cmake -G Ninja -DSECP256K1_BUILD_EXHAUSTIVE_TESTS=ON -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON ${CMAKE_ARGS} -S src -B build
            cd build && cmake --build . && cmake --build . --target check && cmake --build . --target clean
        requirements:
          build:
            - ${{ compiler('c') }}
            - brush
            - cmake >=3.26
            - ninja
            - pkg-config
        files:
          recipe:
            - shared_standalone_tests/
          source:
            - src/
            - include/
            - contrib/
            - cmake/
      # - downstream: libsecp256k1-py-bindings
      - downstream: coincurve

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Runtime package: versioned shared library only.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  - package:
      name: libsecp256k1-${{ so_major_version }}
      version: ${{ version }}
    inherit: build-cache
    build:
      files:
        - if: linux
          then:
            - lib/libsecp256k1.so.${{ so_major_version }}
            - lib/libsecp256k1.so.${{ so_version }}
        - if: osx
          then:
            - lib/libsecp256k1.${{ so_major_version }}.dylib
        - if: not unix
          then:
            - ${{ library }}bin/libsecp256k1-${{ so_major_version }}.dll
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libsecp256k1-' ~ so_major_version) }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          strict: true
          files:
            - if: linux
              then:
                - lib/libsecp256k1.so.${{ so_major_version }}
                - lib/libsecp256k1.so.${{ so_version }}
            - if: osx
              then:
                - lib/libsecp256k1.${{ so_major_version }}.dylib
            - if: not unix
              then:
                - ${{ library }}bin/libsecp256k1-${{ so_major_version }}.dll
